title: Reservations Desk Card: Footwear-Client Relief for Made-to-Order Work Charges (Pre-Orders & Back-Orders)
content:
**Rule.** Footwear-client relief applies to the work charge on a Pre-Orders & Back-Orders Made-to-Order Reservation cancelled in production. It counts the footwear lines booked on the customer's Marlowe & Finch orders, the Online Orders on the customer's profile, in the last 24 months, and multiplies the work charge by the band the count falls in:

| Footwear lines booked, last 24 months | Work charge multiplied by |
|---|---|
| 8 or more | 0.85 |
| 4 up to 7 (4 or more, fewer than 8) | 0.92 |
| Fewer than 4 | 1.0 |

**What is counted.** Order lines of the footwear product class, booked on the customer's Online Orders. Each line is counted by its booking date, and only lines booked within the last 24 months are counted.

**Where the relief acts.** The relief multiplies the work charge as one more factor of the same product of the reserved price and the work share. It applies before the cap at the deposit held and before the rounding to the cent, both of which apply to the whole product.

**Band edges**

| Count | Multiplier |
|---|---|
| 3 | 1.0 |
| 4 | 0.92 |
| 7 | 0.92 |
| 8 | 0.85 |

**Desk example (hypothetical).** A customer's Online Orders show 9 footwear lines in all. Two of them were booked 26 months ago and 7 within the last 24 months. The count is 7, which falls in the band of 4 up to 7, so the multiplier is 0.92.
